proposals.evidence: CDIAL 13211 samāna “same, alike” gives Prakrit samāṇa and Kashmiri samān/Gujarati samāṇu. The simple survey saman/soman forms preserve the whole adjective. Learned renewal or transfer across Indo-Aryan remains possible; this link identifies the lexical family. Any unresolved borrowing between Indo-Aryan languages is retained under the user’s preference for a provisional supported family link.
